name: use-tailwind
description: Use TailwindCSS classes instead of Bootstrap classes
message:
Please use TailwindCSS classes instead of Bootstrap classes. Common replacements:
- container → container mx-auto
- row → flex flex-wrap
- col → flex-1
- btn → px-4 py-2 rounded-md
- card → bg-white rounded-lg shadow
- navbar → bg-white shadow
- form-control → w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md
- alert → p-4 rounded-md
- badge → px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full
- table → w-full
- modal → fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50
- dropdown → relative inline-block
- list-group → space-y-2
- text-center → text-center
- text-right → text-right
- text-left → text-left
- pull-right → float-right
- pull-left → float-left
- clearfix → clear-both
- visible → block
- invisible → hidden
- sr-only → sr-only
- fixed-top → fixed top-0
- fixed-bottom → fixed bottom-0
- sticky-top → sticky top-0
- sticky-bottom → sticky bottom-0
